units.source_text: 下轮对局定在八月十四日。

en.t: The next game was set for August 14.

units.source_text: 名人的身体十分孱弱，病情益发严重，医生禁止他对弈，工作人员也加以劝阻，报社也死心了。

en.t: The Master's body was extremely frail, and his condition grew worse; the doctor forbade him to play, the staff also urged him not to, and the newspaper gave up as well.

units.source_text: 十四日，名人只下了一手，就决定停下这盘棋。

en.t: On the fourteenth, the Master made only one move, then decided to stop the game.
